author: CC
prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12: cairn/tools/artifact/proofs/test_artifact_door.py is red on HEAD on Windows with FileNotFoundError and every declared tooth aborted. Measured here: teeth_callers shells out to systemd-run and env and reads /sys/fs/cgroup (Linux only), so main() catches the first FileNotFoundError and reds all fourteen teeth, hiding the rest. With teeth_callers stubbed out, 2 teeth still fail on this box: 'git commit of a journaled tree passes the hook' (the scratch repo's hook says the artifact door is not reachable, CAIRN_REPO unset in the commit's env) and test_the_tester_hook_asks_the_commit_question_before_the_reseal_ladder (python3 reports No module named cairn.tools.artifact.__main__).
